retirementReasons.theme_controller: Facet install/swap/uninstall controller and its adapter/core settlement lifecycle are deleted. Native StyleLink and reactive StyleSheet are caller-owned Compose nodes.
retirementReasons.theme_snapshot: Frozen environment metric snapshots, solver scaling and metric path resolution façade are removed. Controls read package policy directly; engine computes geometry.
retirementReasons.theme_selectby: Imperative theme-controller selection arbitration is removed. Callers select package readables through Compose formulas.
retirementReasons.theme_roles: Custom solver/renderer role expansion, calibrated text-metrics keys and exact Facet geometry fixtures are removed. Native styles and engine text/layout are authoritative.
retirementReasons.theme_paint_repaint: Renderer dirty/paint operation ordering and adapter fallback repaint paths are deleted. Native StyleRule properties are now materialized directly.
retirementReasons.theme_pixel_content: Solver-wide snapping of application content and renderer decoration hints are removed. Native image resampling remains a control/theme concern.
retirementReasons.theme_drift: Source-scanning the removed theme-controller and solver constants is obsolete; new architecture boundary checks inspect the native surface.
